ctx.x: And he eventually ended up with Dionne Warwick three years ago, or 4 years ago, and he was doing some writing for her, doing some charts, and also playing piano for her. He was the leader with a small group that she would take out, and he played -- oh, I don't know the conductor's name, I saw him in a movie, they made at Wolf Trap; and he had a wonderful future, because Dionne three years ago had some movies coming out and some great things coming, and Bobby had the flu.
